summary: Service/dwell time at the pickup step (seconds).
businessRules: Extends pickup occupancy; counts toward working time and shipment onboard timing.
service defines: Provide the time duration, in seconds, needed to complete the shipment pickup. Default value is 0.
Must stay consistent with: shipments.max_time_in_vehicle. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Interaction: large pickup service can breach max_time_in_vehicle.
